source: public: Volvo 2.0/2.4 D5 (five-cylinder) and 2.0D runs Bosch EDC16C34/EDC16CP34 (earlier) then Bosch EDC17 (later). The D5 five-cylinder diesel is well documented in ECU/tuning databases.
notes: 2.0/2.4 D5 & 2.0D diesels. Candidate ECU set EDC16 -> EDC17 by MY; split not resolved. NO part_numbers shipped: Volvo ECU numbers (e.g. '31xxxxxx', '08xxxxxx') encode Volvo part supersession, not the engine. Context-match only. 0x7E0 CAN UDS.

source: public: Volvo 1.6D (PSA-sourced DV6 engine) and 2.0D (Ford/PSA-shared) run Siemens SID807, Delphi DCM3.5 or Bosch EDC17C10 depending on platform/year. These are the shared PSA/Ford diesels also found in Peugeot/Citroen/Ford/Mazda.
notes: 1.6D/2.0D (PSA/Ford-shared). Family candidate SET across suppliers (Siemens/Delphi/Bosch); not resolved per engine/MY. NO part_numbers shipped. Context-match only. 0x7E0 CAN UDS.
